senses.definition: Make a process, system, or organization simpler and more efficient, often by removing unnecessary steps.
senses.example: We streamlined the review process by removing duplicate approvals.

synonyms.note: emphasizes reducing complexity, not necessarily improving efficiency
improve performance; may involve adding complexity

antonyms.note: make a process harder or more complex

senses.definition: Give an object a smooth shape so that it moves more easily through air or water.
senses.example: The engineers streamlined the vehicle’s body to reduce air resistance.

sources: Direct user approval: add steramline as a card
classification_reason: Useful active vocabulary for discussing process improvements, workflows, and engineering efficiency.
